rows.name: Legal Certainty
rows.description: How firmly the obligation is grounded in current, unambiguous statute or regulation. Score drops when law is in flux, subject to interpretation, or under legislative review.

rows.name: Source Certainty
rows.description: Quality and authority of the sources used to define this obligation. Primary legislation = 10; secondary legislation = 8; official guidance = 6; practitioner community = 4; inferred = 2.

rows.name: Evidence Certainty
rows.description: Clarity about what evidence satisfies this obligation. Score drops when authorities exercise discretion or when accepted evidence formats are ambiguous.

rows.name: Workflow Certainty
rows.description: Clarity about the procedural steps to complete this obligation. Score drops when the process involves undocumented steps or authority-specific variations.

rows.name: Predictive Certainty
rows.description: How predictable the outcome of completing this obligation is. Score drops for obligations where authority discretion is high.

rows.name: Historical Certainty
rows.description: Confidence based on observed case history. Score rises with volume of successfully completed cases following the same obligation pattern.
